meaning: to fall, drop (leaves, rain, the sun setting)

senses.en: to fall, drop (leaves, rain, the sun setting)

note: 日落 = sunset; 落后 = fall behind. 落 in the sense "to be left behind/forget" is read là (separate entry).

examples.zh: 秋天到了，叶子落了一地。
examples.en: Autumn has come, and leaves have fallen all over the ground.

examples.zh: 太阳落山以后，天就黑了。
examples.en: After the sun sets, it gets dark.

examples.zh: 你的手机落在出租车上了吗？
examples.en: Did your phone fall onto the taxi seat?

note: Often 单独 + verb: 单独 谈 (talk privately), 单独 住 (live alone).

examples.zh: 医生想单独跟他谈几句。
examples.en: The doctor wants to talk with him alone for a few words.

examples.zh: 这个问题我想单独问你。
examples.en: I want to ask you this question separately.

examples.zh: 她不敢单独一个人回家。
examples.en: She doesn't dare to go home all by herself.

meaning: opposite, reverse; in the wrong direction

senses.en: opposite, reverse; in the wrong direction

note: Common: 相反 (opposite), 反对 (oppose), 反而 (instead). Here 反 = reversed/inside out.

examples.zh: 你的衣服穿反了，快换。
examples.en: You've put your clothes on inside out; change them quickly.

examples.zh: 这本书拿反了，字都是倒的。
examples.en: You're holding this book the wrong way; the words are upside down.

examples.zh: 我说的话，他听反了。
examples.en: He understood what I said the wrong way round.

note: Used for people, places, brands; a bit more formal than 有名.

examples.zh: 这位著名的医生明天来医院。
examples.en: This famous doctor is coming to the hospital tomorrow.

examples.zh: 这家饭店的菜很著名，人很多。
examples.en: This restaurant's food is well known, and it's crowded.

examples.zh: 他是一位著名的作家吗？
examples.en: Is he a famous writer?

meaning: style (of a person, work, design, or way of doing things)

senses.en: style (of a person, work, design, or way of doing things)

examples.zh: 我喜欢这家饭店的装修风格。
examples.en: I like the decoration style of this restaurant.

examples.zh: 他们两个人的工作风格很不一样。
examples.en: The two of them have very different working styles.

examples.zh: 你喜欢什么风格的衣服？
examples.en: What style of clothes do you like?

meaning: free of charge, to be free

senses.en: free of charge, to be free

note: 免费 + verb: 免费 提供 (provide free). Opposite: 收费.

examples.zh: 这里的停车是免费的吗？
examples.en: Is parking here free?

examples.zh: 学生可以免费参观这个地方。
examples.en: Students can visit this place for free.

examples.zh: 酒店免费提供早饭，你不用付钱。
examples.en: The hotel provides breakfast free; you don't need to pay.

note: Mostly in compounds (方便, 地方, 方法); as a free word it means "square", e.g. 方 桌.

examples.zh: 我们家有一张方桌子。
examples.en: We have a square table at home.

examples.zh: 这张桌子是方的，不是圆的。
examples.en: This table is square, not round.

examples.zh: 你想买圆的还是方的？
examples.en: Do you want to buy a round one or a square one?

meaning: as quickly as possible, as soon as possible

senses.en: as quickly as possible, as soon as possible

note: Put before the verb: 尽快 回复 (reply ASAP). Common in work emails and requests.

examples.zh: 请你尽快把材料发给我。
examples.en: Please send me the materials as soon as possible.

examples.zh: 我会尽快回复你的邮件。
examples.en: I'll reply to your email as soon as I can.

examples.zh: 孩子发烧了，我们得尽快去医院。
examples.en: The child has a fever; we need to go to the hospital quickly.

examples.zh: 我女儿最爱吃巧克力。
examples.en: My daughter loves eating chocolate most.

examples.zh: 请给我一块巧克力。
examples.en: Please give me a piece of chocolate.

examples.zh: 吃太多巧克力对牙不好。
examples.en: Eating too much chocolate is bad for your teeth.

note: 不 辣 / 微辣 / 特辣 are handy when ordering. Also: 辣椒 (chili).

examples.zh: 这个菜太辣了，我吃不了。
examples.en: This dish is too spicy; I can't eat it.

examples.zh: 我朋友生病了，不能吃辣的。
examples.en: My friend is sick and can't eat spicy food.

examples.zh: 你们的汤辣不辣？
examples.en: Is your soup spicy?

meaning: to choose, pick out (also: carry on a pole)

senses.en: to choose, pick out (also: carry on a pole)

note: Read tiāo for "choose". 挑 + 好 / 挑 一 个 are everyday uses.

examples.zh: 你帮我挑一件衣服，好吗？
examples.en: Can you help me pick out a piece of clothing?

examples.zh: 水果太多了，我不知道怎么挑。
examples.en: There's so much fruit; I don't know how to choose.

examples.zh: 他挑了半天，还是没买。
examples.en: He picked for ages and still didn't buy anything.

note: Usually 打结 (tie a knot). In 结婚 and 结果 it has other senses.

examples.zh: 这个结太紧，我打不开。
examples.en: This knot is too tight; I can't undo it.

examples.zh: 请帮我打一个结。
examples.en: Please help me tie a knot.

examples.zh: 他在衣服上打了一个结。
examples.en: He tied a knot in the clothes.

note: 切 + 菜/肉/水果; 切 成 片 = cut into slices. Read qiē when "cut".

examples.zh: 请把西瓜切成小块。
examples.en: Please cut the watermelon into small pieces.

examples.zh: 我切菜的时候，不小心切到手了。
examples.en: While cutting vegetables, I accidentally cut my hand.

examples.zh: 肉要切薄一点儿，好吗？
examples.en: Slice the meat a bit thinner, please.

note: 彻底 + verb/adj: 彻底 改变, 彻底 解决, 彻底 忘记.

examples.zh: 房间要彻底打扫，太脏了。
examples.en: The room needs a thorough cleaning; it's too dirty.

examples.zh: 这次旅行让他彻底放松了。
examples.en: This trip let him relax completely.

examples.zh: 这个问题还没有彻底解决。
examples.en: This problem hasn't been completely solved yet.

meaning: to turn over, flip; to search through; to translate

senses.en: to turn over, flip; to search through; to translate

note: Common: 翻 页, 翻译, 翻 包 (rummage through a bag).

examples.zh: 请翻到第十页，我们开始读。
examples.en: Please turn to page ten; we'll start reading.

examples.zh: 我翻了半天包，也没找到手机。
examples.en: I rummaged through my bag for ages and couldn't find my phone.

examples.zh: 他昨天晚上翻来翻去，怎么也睡不着。
examples.en: Last night he tossed and turned and couldn't fall asleep.

meaning: to put, arrange, set out; to wave

senses.en: to put, arrange, set out; to wave

note: 摆 + 东西/桌子: 把 东西 摆 好 (put things in place).

examples.zh: 请把椅子摆在桌子旁边。
examples.en: Please put the chairs next to the table.

examples.zh: 他们在门口摆了好几张椅子。
examples.en: They set out several chairs at the entrance.

examples.zh: 书摆得太乱，你重新整理。
examples.en: The books are arranged too messily; tidy them up again.

note: 申请 + 签证/工作/奖学金; also a noun: 一 份 申请.

examples.zh: 我想申请一个新的工作。
examples.en: I want to apply for a new job.

examples.zh: 你的工作申请办好了吗？
examples.en: Has your job application been processed?

examples.zh: 请在这里填申请表。
examples.en: Please fill in the application form here.

meaning: to cause, give rise to, arouse

senses.en: to cause, give rise to, arouse

note: 引起 + 注意/问题/兴趣/误会; the object is usually an abstract thing.

examples.zh: 他的话引起了大家的注意。
examples.en: His words drew everyone's attention.

examples.zh: 这个药可能会引起肚子疼。
examples.en: This medicine may cause a stomachache.

examples.zh: 这句话引起了一个大误会。
examples.en: This sentence caused a big misunderstanding.

note: 大学 毕业 = graduate from university; 毕业 后 = after graduating.

examples.zh: 我哥哥明年大学毕业。
examples.en: My older brother graduates from university next year.

examples.zh: 你毕业以后想做什么工作？
examples.en: What job do you want to do after you graduate?

examples.zh: 她去年就毕业了，现在在银行上班。
examples.en: She graduated last year and now works at a bank.

note: Often figurative or literary; for an ordinary dark room, 黑 is more common.

examples.zh: 房间里黑暗，什么也看不见。
examples.en: The room was dark; nothing could be seen.

examples.zh: 孩子怕黑暗，晚上要开着灯。
examples.en: The child is afraid of the dark and needs a light on at night.

examples.zh: 他终于从黑暗的日子里走出来了。
examples.en: He finally came out of those dark days.
